best_idea: A cast is a timed object: check the gates at start (cooldown, GCD, mana), but spend mana and start the cooldown only when the cast completes, and drop the whole cast with nothing spent when a crowd-control buff lands.
decision_why: The start-gate / completion-spend split and the CC-drops-cast rule fit a server-verified engine; the donor's gaps (GCD set at completion, no busy check, undefined hit rule) and its defects (Random.Shared.Next(0,1) always 0; dead ChannelingMana; unread AoeDiminishing flag and stub reset) are fixed in the sketch, not copied.
acceptance: A player casting a 1.5 s spell who is stunned at 0.6 s sees the cast bar stop, mana unchanged, and the spell's cooldown not started; a completed cast takes its mana once and starts the cooldown; a server test asserts both.
